connections.why: Changing family life reshapes how children are raised and schooled
The education system prepares — and stratifies — entry into working life
Gender equality at work is bound up with shifting roles in the family
Media coverage and freedom of expression shape the rise of the far right
Music and festivals are two faces of the same Francophone artistic culture
Immigration's benefits and its challenges are two sides of the same theme
Marginalisation and integration debates fuel far-right political movements
The German Occupation and the collaborationist Vichy regime are inseparable
The Resistance defined itself against Vichy collaboration and Pétain
Antisemitism and authoritarianism link wartime collaboration to far-right ideology
Begag's novel dramatises immigrant marginalisation and integration
La Haine portrays banlieue alienation at the heart of the immigration theme
Entre les murs is a direct study of the French education system
Les Choristes explores schooling, discipline and second chances
Intouchables stages cross-cultural friendship and integration
Un Sac de Billes follows Jewish boys fleeing across occupied France
Au Revoir les Enfants dramatises antisemitism under the Occupation
Jeunet's film evokes wartime France and its lasting wounds
Le Dernier Métro is set in a theatre under German Occupation
La Vie en Rose centres on a defining figure of French popular music
Skills in reading the press feed independent research from authentic sources
Critical analysis of a set text builds the argumentation the IRP demands
Rich, well-documented social themes make strong IRP subjects
A well-framed topic determines what research is needed
Researched material is the basis of the oral presentation and discussion
